name: 1_configs
description: GHA workflows + ship-engine generator. Source: src/cicd/*.yml + src/scripts/*.sh -> Dist: .github/workflows/*.yml + 1_configs/dist/scripts/. Runner-image registry topology lives in cloud-builders-runner.json.

deploy.note: Outputs are .github/workflows/ and dist/scripts/ — committed to git.

runners_doc: Runner-image registry topology (arch -> {type, host?, builder_image?, runs_on, docker_arch, uname}) now lives in 1_configs/cloud-builders-runner.json (single source of truth, extracted 2026-08-09). 1_configs/src/engines/derive-build-workflows.ts prefers cloud-builders-runner.json's .runners when present, falling back to this file's .runners (removed here — kept only as a fallback contract) for older checkouts missing the new file. Consumed by 1_configs/src/scripts/cloud-ship-container-step-build-docker.sh and cloud-ship-ci-builder-dispatch.sh via 1_configs/dist/build-workflows.json (symlinked from 1_configs/src/build-workflows.json). 1_configs/build.sh aggregates the runners + this build.json's probe + dispatch fields into dist/build-workflows.json. amd64 = local build on the x86 GHA runner (ubuntu-latest). arm64 = local build on the native GHA arm64 runner (ubuntu-24.04-arm) — the Ship job's runs-on is selected per-VM-arch in .github/workflows/ship.yml (detect job derives runner from .vms[].specs.arch), so both arches build natively on the arch-matching hosted runner with NO QEMU and NO SSH dispatch. Migrated 2026-08-07 off the oci-apps ssh cloud-builder-x runner (cold arm64 builds exceeded the ship clock on the cacheless, disk-pressured VM). The ssh runner-type path and .probe/.dispatch tunables remain in the engine for any future remote-builder arch but are currently unused. Probe retry/backoff lets the engine survive transient SSH timeouts on any ssh-type runner (WG flap, sshd MaxStartups burst).
dispatch_doc: Async build dispatch: engine writes the docker-run command to a remote script, launches it via nohup (detached from the SSH session), and polls a status file. Survives WG flaps / sshd restarts during long builds — the build keeps running on the runner; the engine just reconnects to read status.
